descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S12 「打开两份医院病历 → 两条访问记录行，每条写明病人和医生」 Two Hospital charts opened -> two access rows, each naming patient and physician

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send …（UAT OAT-01 step 5；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 7；TFA-94513 AC 12；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given AUDIT_USER signed in through the browser, with two Hospital patients

When Open chart A, then chart B

Then There is a PHI_READ row for each chart, with resource_id and patient_id equal to that patient, actor_id equal to the physician, context 'rounding.patient', and a creation time.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：audit.spec.ts assertions (presence per chart), judged against U5 for the 'view' action in Hospital. Whether PHI_READ is an acceptable spelling of 'view' is Q6; whether in-app chart opens are enough for 'every patient access' is Q14 (S15).

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
